title: When you cannot castle
line: After the king or that rook has moved, out of check, through check or into check.

steps.text: If the king has moved, even once and back, it can never castle in that game. A rook that has moved cannot castle either.
A king attacked by an enemy piece is in check. A king in check may not castle: here the bishop on b4 gives check.
The king may not cross a square an enemy piece attacks. Tap the square the king would cross to castle short.

wrong.g1: The king would land there, but first it crosses the square next to it.

steps.after: The bishop attacks the square next to the king, so White cannot castle short.

steps.text: Nor may the king land on an attacked square. Tap the square where it would land.
steps.after: The rook attacks that square, so castling short is not allowed.

steps.text: Here the short side is closed by the bishop on c4. Castle on the long side.

also.b2b3: That is a sound move too, but this step asks you to castle.

summary: No castling once the king or that rook has moved, while in check, or across or onto an attacked square.
